description: Known disagreements with verbecc, checked by scripts/crosscheck.py. In every case listed here our form is the correct one. person is 0-5 (yo..ellos) or *, tense is a tense id or *.
adjectival_participles_reason: verbecc uses the adjectival participle (nato, electo, salvo...) in compound tenses. The RAE uses the regular participle there (he nacido, han elegido); the short form is only an adjective.

exceptions.reason: Compounds of tener write the tú command with an accent (abstén); verbecc drops it.
contén needs its accent (aguda ending in n); verbecc drops it.
detén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
entretén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
mantén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
obtén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
retén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
sostén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
Compounds of venir write the tú command with an accent (contravén); verbecc drops it.
convén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
intervén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
prevén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
provén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
sobrevén needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
prevés, prevé, prevéis, prevén are two-syllable words stressed on the last syllable and need accents; verbecc copies the unaccented forms of ver.
preví, previó need accents (unlike the one-syllable vi, vio); verbecc drops them.
prevé needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
Same as prever: entrevés, entrevé, entrevéis, entrevén need accents.
Same as prever: entreví, entrevió need accents.
entrevé needs its accent; verbecc drops it.
verbecc conjugates complacer like archaic placer (complugo, complega). Modern complacer is a regular -zc verb: complació, complazca.
c becomes z before a/o: esparzo, esparza. verbecc writes esparco, esparca.
The o→ue change after g is written güe: degüello, degüelle. verbecc drops the dieresis.
We teach aterrar 'to terrify', which is regular (aterro). verbecc conjugates the archaic aterrar 'to bring down' (atierro).
verbecc produces nonsense for acaecer (acaeacha). It conjugates like other -ecer verbs: acaece, acaeció, acaezca.
